cmd:
import hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
fz,mut,sc=Path(sys.argv[1]),Path(sys.argv[2]),Path(sys.argv[3]); out={}
for p in sorted(mut.glob("M*.patch")):
    text=p.read_bytes().decode("utf-8"); rel=text.splitlines()[0].split("--- a/",1)[1]
    d=sc/"mcheck"/p.stem; shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True); (d/rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True); shutil.copyfile(fz/rel,d/rel)
    before=hashlib.sha256((d/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    chk=subprocess.run(["git","apply","--check",str(p)],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
    app=subprocess.run(["git","apply",str(p)],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
    src=(d/rel).read_bytes(); after=hashlib.sha256(src).hexdigest()
    try: compile(src.decode("utf-8"),rel,"exec"); comp="ok"
    except SyntaxError as e: comp=f"SyntaxError: {e}"
    files=sorted(str(x.relative_to(d)).replace("\\","/") for x in d.rglob("*") if x.is_file())
    out[p.stem]={"file":rel,"patch_sha256":hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),"frozen_sha256":before,"frozen_matches":before==hashlib.sha256((fz/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"git_apply_check_exit":chk.returncode,"git_apply_check_err":chk.stderr.strip()[:200],"git_apply_exit":app.returncode,"git_apply_err":app.stderr.strip()[:200],"mutated_sha256":after,"changed":after!=before,"compile":comp,"files_in_scratch":files,"hunks":text.count("\n@@ ")}
print(json.dumps(out,indent=1))
